records.source: 'per_field' analyses arriving fields independently. 'fixed_map' waits for every image declared in conversion_map.csv, then runs the ordinary static projected v1 Mask or Mask/Measure batch pipeline with shared legacy percentile normalization and padding. Requires randomize False and batch_size greater than 1. Incomplete cohorts remain waiting; timeouts never release partial pools. Membership, recipes and original input hashes bind one restart-safe checkpoint. Default 'per_field'.
records.translation: 'per_field' analyse indépendamment les champs qui arrivent. 'fixed_map' attend chaque image déclarée dans conversion_map.csv, puis lance le traitement habituel par lots de Mask ou Mask/Measure, statique et projeté v1, avec la normalisation historique par percentiles et le remplissage partagés. Exige randomize False et batch_size supérieur à 1. Les groupes incomplets restent en attente ; les délais ne libèrent jamais de groupes partiels. La composition, les recettes et les empreintes des entrées originales lient un point de contrôle sûr après redémarrage. Valeur par défaut 'per_field'.

records.key: A crisp gravitational dot field with optional local mouse influence and expanding ripples.
records.source: A crisp gravitational dot field with optional local mouse influence and expanding ripples.
records.translation: Un champ gravitationnel de points nets avec une influence locale facultative de la souris et des ondulations qui se propagent.

records.key: A lit window in the dark: warm orange on near-black, fine paper facets behind it, and a sound set in G minor at 118 BPM.
records.source: A lit window in the dark: warm orange on near-black, fine paper facets behind it, and a sound set in G minor at 118 BPM.
records.translation: Une fenêtre éclairée dans l’obscurité : orange chaud sur un fond presque noir, fines facettes de papier derrière et un ensemble sonore en sol mineur à 118 BPM.

records.key: A single branching front advances continuously while its trail fades, occupying at most 25% of the backdrop.
records.source: A single branching front advances continuously while its trail fades, occupying at most 25% of the backdrop.
records.translation: Un unique front ramifié avance continuellement tandis que sa trace s’efface, occupant au plus 25% du fond.

records.key: An edge-free landscape of round points carries wide travelling waves.
records.source: An edge-free landscape of round points carries wide travelling waves.
records.translation: Un paysage sans bord de points ronds porte de larges ondes progressives.

records.key: Deep water, green-black and slow: waves travelling through points, and a sound set in E minor at 116 BPM with the heaviest sub of the ten.
records.source: Deep water, green-black and slow: waves travelling through points, and a sound set in E minor at 116 BPM with the heaviest sub of the ten.
records.translation: Eau profonde, vert-noir et lente : des ondes traversent les points, avec un ensemble sonore en mi mineur à 116 BPM dont les basses profondes sont les plus lourdes des dix.

records.key: Fine curtains of northern light ripple through softly layered folds.
records.source: Fine curtains of northern light ripple through softly layered folds.
records.translation: De fins rideaux d’aurores boréales ondulent dans des plis doucement superposés.

records.key: Fine paper facets move gently and respond locally to the mouse.
records.source: Fine paper facets move gently and respond locally to the mouse.
records.translation: De fines facettes de papier bougent doucement et réagissent localement à la souris.

records.key: Fine particles form evolving vortices and branching currents, with optional mouse gravity.
records.source: Fine particles form evolving vortices and branching currents, with optional mouse gravity.
records.translation: De fines particules forment des tourbillons évolutifs et des courants ramifiés, avec une gravité de souris facultative.

records.key: Furthest from the sun: cold violet, point waves travelling through the dark, and a tense sound set in D harmonic minor at 128 BPM.
records.source: Furthest from the sun: cold violet, point waves travelling through the dark, and a tense sound set in D harmonic minor at 128 BPM.
records.translation: Au plus loin du soleil : violet froid, ondes de points traversant l’obscurité et ensemble sonore tendu en ré mineur harmonique à 128 BPM.

records.key: How far mouse gravity reaches, as a percentage of the shorter screen edge. Zero disables mouse influence. Applies to backgrounds that respond to the mouse.
records.source: How far mouse gravity reaches, as a percentage of the shorter screen edge. Zero disables mouse influence. Applies to backgrounds that respond to the mouse.
records.translation: Portée de la gravité de la souris en pourcentage du côté le plus court de l’écran. Zéro désactive l’influence de la souris. S’applique aux arrière-plans qui réagissent à la souris.
Rayon de gravité de la souris

records.key: The long low light of a year's turn: olive and pale gold, fine paper facets through it, and a sound set in G Lydian at 112 BPM.
records.source: The long low light of a year's turn: olive and pale gold, fine paper facets through it, and a sound set in G Lydian at 112 BPM.
records.translation: La lumière longue et basse du tournant de l’année : olive et or pâle, fines facettes de papier et ensemble sonore en sol lydien à 112 BPM.
